retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, heavily grained nocturnal landscape featuring a central silhouetted tree illuminated by a harsh, saturated red light source against a dark, textured sky.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, lo-fi composition dominated by a central leafless tree silhouette. The scene is split between a deep black foreground and a vibrant, grainy red glow that suggests an artificial or infrared light source. The texture is characterized by extreme noise and analog film artifacts.
coreVisualRelationships: Central tree silhouette against a glowing red background
High contrast between deep black shadows and saturated red highlights
Uniform heavy grain texture across all color fields
Horizontal division of ground and sky with a soft, hazy transition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A single, medium-scale leafless tree positioned slightly off-center, acting as the primary vertical element.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The base of the tree where the red light is most intense against the dark ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright red glow in the center-right, follows the tree silhouette upward, and then settles into the dark, grainy negative space on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space in the lower foreground and upper left quadrant, emphasizing the isolation of the tree.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant Crimson Red (Light Source and Sky)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red channel with very low value in the shadows, creating a binary, high-contrast feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a nocturnal landscape with a central silhouetted tree. Apply a heavy, coarse film grain texture. Use a single, intense red light source from the right side that illuminates the ground and sky, leaving the left side in deep black shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist sans-serif font with high tracking, placed in the dark negative space, using a muted grey or dark red color to maintain the lo-fi aesthetic.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture coarse and visible?
Is the red color highly saturated?
Is the tree a distinct silhouette?
Is the foreground almost entirely black?

adjustableVariables: Ratio of black to red space
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no blue or green pixels are present
Verify the grain is uniform and not just a digital overlay
Check that the tree silhouette remains the focal point
recipe.reuseFormula: Nocturnal silhouette + Saturated red light + Heavy analog grain = Lo-fi Liminal Landscape
